name: Hyecho's pilgrimage to the five Indias
summary: A young Silla monk sails from Guangzhou to India, visits the holy places of the Buddha, and walks home to China through Kashmir, Gandhara and the Pamirs, noting Arab armies in Tokharistan and the Türks beyond. He never went back to Silla. His account, Wang ocheonchukguk jeon, was lost until Paul Pelliot found a copy at Dunhuang in 1908.
